tooltip: Wood — found at the Basketball and Badminton Courts. Used in crafting and as Crockpot fuel.
Metal — found at the Basketball Court and Rayman's House. Crafts weapons and repairs.
Cloth — found everywhere; abundant at Ellie & Luca's and Badminton. Bandages and comfort items.
Provisions — found everywhere; abundant at the kitchen and James's House. Eat uncooked or cook for more.
Energy Drink — only at James's House. +2 Sanity. James MUST drink one per day or lose Sanity.
Battery — at James's and Rayman's Houses. Powers electronics; needed for Flashlights.
The Doom marker. Hover to see current step and the next threshold.
The Day Counter. Advances at each Dawn. Game ends after Day 7.
Severity dot legend — see how punishing a Dawn or Threat card is at a glance.
The Sanity d8. Rolled when an event causes variable Sanity loss.
Phase 1 Dawn deck — Dusk of the Week. Calm days. Mild events.
Phase 2 Dawn deck — Strange Days. Threats appear. Pressure rises.
Phase 3 Dawn deck — Long Nights. Boss night. Heavy disruption.
Phase 4 Dawn deck — Final Hours. Survival sprint. Doom races.
The Market deck. Spend resources to claim Items from the 5-card display.
The Threat deck. Drawn at Night based on each location's threat rate.
A Recipe. Cook at the Crockpot to feed and revive the team.
The Telltale Heart supply. Cooked from 1 Cloth + 1 Battery + 1 Provisions + 2 cook's Health. Used to revive a Down character.
Your character's board. Stats on the left; perks in the middle; Action Bar at the bottom.
A character standee. The active player's standee bobs gently.
A boss. Larger than character standees. Disrupts rules while present.
James's House. The Den (free trade once per day). James gains +1 Sanity sleeping here.
Rayman's House. The Garage (Rest +1 Health). Rayman gains +1 Health sleeping here. +1 defense.
Ellie & Luca's House. The Kitchen (permanent Crockpot). Ellie/Luca gain +1 Sanity sleeping here. +1 Sanity at Tick.
The School's Basketball Court. Echoes: each gather rolls a d6 with bonus or penalty. -1 Sanity at Tick. -1 defense.
The Badminton Court. The Net: +1 defense die. -1 Sanity at Tick. Highest threat draw rate at Night.
